messages:
sam: Heads-up from the postmortemwe need to get owners and shortest-path timelines for GPU capacity + autoscale remediation. Quick sync here so tracker isn't the only source.

ivy: I can own the scheduler tuning experiments (binpack vs spread heuristics). Goal: config draft by Mon, 36h canary mid-week.

nate: I'll take headroom sims and the per-zone heatmaps. Plan: baseline replay then +20% spike. ETA 72h for first artifacts.

mira: I'll manage the tracker and alerts. Created a bare-bones sheet: https://go.redwood/incident-2045 - please add links/runbooks.

sam: nate, can you confirm you'll include p999 and tail-util by GPU family? That's what the product teams care about most.

nate: yes - p50/p95/p99/p999 and tail-util by zone + GPU SKU. Also will include GPU-hours delta and a simple $ estimate.

ops-bot: [automated] Created task INC-2045-01: Headroom replay (owner=nate) due=2026-04-12.

finance-bot: [automated] Temporary burst credits available for up to 96h. Formal reserved increases >12% require finance signoff.

ivy: scheduler preview (conservative start) below. Will attach full diff in tracker.

```
# scheduler conservative diff
scoreWeights:
  binpack: 1.1
  spread: 0.9
preemption:
  enabled: true
  minPriorityDelta: 1500
maxPodBurst: 10
```

mira: added PD rule PD-2210: tail-util-zone-warning -> fires when tail-util > 77% for 90m in any zone. Linked runbook and assigned oncall.

sam: ownership recap: ivy=scheduler tuning + canary, nate=headroom sims + cost, mira=tracker+alerts+runbook. Deadlines: ivy Mon draft, nate 72h sims, mira add alerts+dashboard.

nate: infra ask: need a staging cluster with matching GPU drivers. @mira can you open CL?

mira: opened CL-522. ETA kubeconfig in tracker in ~8h.

sam: small procurement note: finance-bot says temporary burst is ok but track spend. nate, capture GPU-hour burn and estimate a 30-day projection.

nate: will include cost delta and a conservative 30-day extrapolation. Also plan two replay windows to cover diurnal behavior.

ivy: canary acceptance: promote if p999 drops >=12% and cost delta <=7%. Fail-fast: auto-rollback if p999 up >10% or queue length increases >25%.

ops-bot: [automated] Created task INC-2045-02: Canary dry-run (owner=ivy) due=2026-04-10.

mira: scheduled a 20m pre-canary runway to validate emergency drain and smoke-test LLM calls. ops-bot: meeting scheduled -> Remediation preflight 2026-04-10 13:40 UTC.

finance-bot: [automated] Noted: reserved commit requires exec approval if projected monthly cost delta > $5k post-change.

sam: any blockers?

nate: waiting on kubeconfig, otherwise clear.

ivy: will post config diff to tracker by EOD today.

mira: added a weekly headroom review recurrence (4 weeks) to monitor tail utilization after rollout. ops-bot created recurrence R-2045-WK.

ops-bot: [automated] Created recurring: Weekly headroom review. Next run=2026-04-13.

sam: OK. Quick action list from this thread: 1) ivy - config draft + canary plan; 2) nate - sims + cost delta; 3) mira - tracker links, PD rule, cluster ticket; 4) sam - coordinate exec ask if cost > $5k. Reconvene Fri 09:00 for quick tape-in, otherwise async in tracker.

mira: tagged postmortem in tracker and added verification checklist. Leaving short updates here; all artifacts in the sheet.

ops-bot: [automated reminder] Remediation preflight -> 2026-04-10 13:40 UTC. Reminder 15m before.
